name: gizza-ai/jsonl-stats
summary: Summarize JSON Lines key coverage, types, and value distributions.

tool.description: Profile JSON Lines / NDJSON text. Counts records, reports per-key presence frequency and coverage, value-type distribution, optional distinct scalar counts, sample values, numeric min/max/mean, string length ranges, nested dotted paths, and invalid-line handling. Outputs text, JSON, Markdown, or CSV.

depth.description: Nested key depth to profile. 1 reports top-level keys; larger values add dotted object paths and [] array-element paths such as user.id or items[].sku.

distinct.description: Include an approximate distinct scalar value count per key, capped and shown as N+ after the internal tracking limit.

format.description: Output format: aligned text report, structured JSON, Markdown table, or CSV.

input.description: JSON Lines / NDJSON text: one complete JSON value per non-blank line. Object records are profiled by key; invalid lines can be reported, skipped, or treated as errors.

invalid.description: Invalid-line handling: report counts and examples, skip invalid lines silently except for the count, or stop at the first parse error.

max_keys.description: Maximum keys to include in the report. 0 reports every profiled key after sorting.

samples.description: Number of first distinct scalar sample values to show per key, from 0 to 5.

sort.description: Sort reported keys by record coverage frequency, alphabetic key name, or first-seen order in the file.

value_stats.description: Include numeric min/max/mean and string length min/max summaries where applicable.
